skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Route video editing requests to the right RunComfy model for restyles, background changes, packaging swaps, motion transfer, and outfit edits.
skill.summary: Edit existing videos through RunComfy with intent-based model routing.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: The high-severity filesystem alerts are false positives caused by placeholder URLs containing ellipses, and most external command alerts are markdown code formatting. The skill does intentionally invoke the RunComfy CLI and submit media URLs to a third-party API, so users should treat it as an external-service video editing integration.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is core behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command examples explicit, require user confirmation before running RunComfy commands, and avoid interpolating untrusted prompt text into a shell string.

remediation.issue: User media and prompts are processed by RunComfy servers.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy notice before submissions and advise users not to send confidential footage without reviewing RunComfy data policies.

remediation.issue: Credential storage depends on the RunComfy CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Continue documenting token file permissions and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI or container environments.

content.value_statement: Choosing the wrong video model wastes time and credits. This skill routes each edit request to the best RunComfy model and provides focused prompt patterns.
actual_capabilities: Routes general restyle, background swap, and packaging edits to Wan 2.7 Edit-Video.
Routes precise motion transfer requests to Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Routes lightweight identity-stable outfit and scene restyles to Lucy Edit Restyle.
Provides RunComfy CLI command examples with model-specific input fields.
Documents duration, resolution, audio, and reference media constraints for each route.
Includes prompting guidance for identity, motion, framing, and localized edits.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account, local RunComfy CLI, and valid authentication.
Submits media URLs and prompts to RunComfy model servers for processing.
Each request uses one selected route and does not blend multiple models.
Output limits depend on the selected model, including duration and resolution caps.

use_cases.title: Restyle a product or creator clip
use_cases.description: Change a background, lighting style, or packaging look while preserving motion and framing.

use_cases.title: Transfer motion to a character
use_cases.description: Map motion from a reference video onto a target character using the Kling route.

use_cases.title: Apply identity-stable outfit changes
use_cases.description: Use Lucy Edit Restyle for localized wardrobe or scene edits that should preserve face and movement.

prompt_templates.title: Basic background swap
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one source video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this video with a new background. Preserve the person, pose, motion, and original audio. Use this source video URL: [video URL].

prompt_templates.title: Product packaging replacement
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using a video and reference image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace the product packaging in this video using the reference image. Keep the hands, camera motion, and framing unchanged. Video: [video URL]. Reference image: [image URL].

prompt_templates.title: Motion transfer to a character
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs Kling motion control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Transfer the movement from this reference video to the target character image. Preserve character identity and keep the motion natural. Image: [image URL]. Motion video: [video URL].

prompt_templates.title: Choose the best edit route
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request where the user wants routing help.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to edit this video: [goal]. Compare the available RunComfy routes, choose one model, explain why, and prepare the CLI command inputs.

output_examples.input: Restyle a talking-head clip so the speaker appears in a modern office.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7 Edit-Video, prioritizes face and lip-motion preservation, keeps original audio, and prepares a RunComfy command.

output_examples.input: Make my target character dance like the person in this reference video.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control, treats the video as the motion reference, and uses the image as the target identity source.

output_examples.input: Change the outfit in a short walking video to business attire.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Lucy Edit Restyle, keeps the edit localized to clothing, and avoids full character replacement.

best_practices: State preservation goals first, then describe one requested change.
Use reference images only when a visual design or appearance must be transferred.
Check model limits for duration, resolution, audio, and aspect ratio before running the command.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated edits in one request because motion and identity can drift.
Do not submit confidential footage unless third-party processing is approved.
Do not use Lucy Restyle for full character replacement or precise motion mapping.

faq.question: Does this skill edit videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to submit jobs to RunComfy model servers.

faq.question: Which model is used by default?
faq.answer: Wan 2.7 Edit-Video is the default when the user does not specify a more specialized route.

faq.question: Can it preserve original audio?
faq.answer: Yes, supported routes include audio options such as origin audio or keep original sound.

faq.question: Can it use a reference image?
faq.answer: Yes. Reference images are useful for packaging, costume, character, or target appearance transfer.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Requirements vary by route, but each route needs a prompt and at least one video or image URL.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with private media?
faq.answer: Use caution. Media URLs and prompts are processed by RunComfy servers, so confirm your privacy requirements first.
